name: Markport - Image Clipper
description: An image library and reference boards for your vault (folders, tags, smart folders, masonry grid, details, full screen; 3D models with a live viewer, flipbooks, PSD/TIFF/RAW and more; boards are .canvas files you can pin over other apps), plus saving images and screenshots from any web page with the Markport Clipper browser extension (src/browser-extension).
author: Markport
